people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,
translations.bsb: Moses replied, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
translations.asv: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will arm yourselves to go before Jehovah to the war,
